articles.headline: If You Invested $100 In Equinix Stock 20 Years Ago, You Would Have This Much Today
articles.summary: Equinix (NASDAQ:EQIX) has outperformed the market over the past 20 years by 5.97% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 15.19%. Currently, Equinix has a market capitalization of $103.05 billion.
